name: news-create
description: Create and publish one Tradebee website news article after explicit confirmation.

language.description: Required exact language selected from languages-get.

newsgroup_id.description: Required positive ID selected from newsgroup-read under the same language.

publication_date.description: Required valid display date, normally yyyy/M/d.

name.description: Required image file label when cover_image is supplied.

base64.description: Required image data with MIME prefix when cover_image is supplied, for example image/jpeg;base64,...; decoded size must not exceed 500 kB.

tags.description: Required 1 to 6 tags; each 3 to 50 characters.

description.description:
Required news-body HTML fragment. Before generating this field, call `rule-get` with the exact selected `language` and exact `scene=news.description`. Generate the description only after that call succeeds and follow the complete returned rule payload instead of guessing layout, styling, structure, theme, or link rules. The current rule requires one root `
` with a unique scoped class and one embedded `

title.description: Optional SEO title, up to 90 characters.

description.description: Optional SEO description, up to 200 characters.

keywords.description: Optional comma-separated SEO keywords, up to 6 keywords and 120 total characters.

confirmation.description: Required explicit approval and summary for the exact payload.

approved.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approves this operation.

summary.description: Summary of the exact language and news payload approved by the user.

output.description: API result containing data.news_id and data.url on success.
